{{Quote|Every starship maker in the galaxy knows the Xi Charrians have an exclusive contract to build droid starfighters for the Trade Federation.|[[Boll Trinkatta]]|<ref name="Lost Jedi">''[[Episode I Adventures 1: Search for the Lost Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Xi Charrians''' were a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-minded]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]] who communicated through a complex variety of clicks. They followed the [[Xi Char/Legends|Xi Char]] religion, and were founders of the [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] company.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', xvi.</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:VultureDroidWalk-SWCTP.png|thumb|210px|Xi Charrians looked like Vulture Droid starfighters in patrol mode. Vulture Droids were designed by the Xi Charrians for the Trade Federation.]]
Their short bodies were covered in [[Chitin/Legends|chitinous]] plates, and were quadrupedal, with pointed, "scissor-action" feet. Xi Charrians' heads were teardrop-shaped and had red [[Eye/Legends|eye]]-slits.

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|A Xi Charrian whose name I'm not even going to attempt to pronounce.|[[Dyne]]|<ref name="LOE" />}}
The Xi Charrians founded a fanatical religious order known as the [[Xi Char/Legends|Xi Char]] which was dedicated to high-precision manufacturing. The Xi Char formed [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]], a company in which their zealots worked tirelessly to produce experimental [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and engine technologies. Haor Chall was one of the more unusual manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], creating huge cathedral factories,<ref name="NEGVV" /> such as [[Workshop Xcan]],<ref name="LOE" /> for their production lines. Notable Haor Chall designs included the [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class droid tank]], the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighter]],<ref name="NEGVV" /> and the [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|''Scarab''-class droid starfighter]].<ref name="Starships of the Galaxy Saga Edition">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]], 79.</ref> It was rumored that the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] arranged a merger between Hoar Chall Engineering and [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], although this was never confirmed by Baktoid.<ref name="NEGVV3">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', xv.</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Do you think the Xi Char will talk to us?''"<br />"''They've every reason to be accommodating. After the Battle of Naboo, the Republic refused to do any business with them, for their having supplied the Neimoidians with proscribed weapons. They've been eager to atone ever since, especially now that their signature designs are being mass-produced more cheaply by Baktoid Armor and other Confederacy suppliers.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="LOE" />}}
The Xi Charrians were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]],<ref name="LOE" /> located in the [[Charros system/Legends|Charros system]] of the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]], a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and about three [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.<ref name="LOE" />

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] became aware of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] coordinating the Clone Wars. One avenue in their attempts to track down his identity led them to the [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Discovering Gunray had been in contact with Sidious through a [[hyperwave receiver]] built in to the chair, the Jedi Order tried to trace the chair's origins. The chair had been engraved by a Xi Charrian, who had signed his name with his personal sigil.

During the Clone Wars, a Republic taskforce of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Battle of the Charros system|invaded]] Charros IV. They successfully destroyed the Haor Chall factories, effectively crippling the company. The company's remaining assets were absorbed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], including Haor Chall's patent on the [[Haor Chall Ring Drive Jell|Hoar Chall Ring Drive Gel]].<ref name="NEGVV" />

==Xi Charrians in the galaxy==
[[t'laalak-s'lalak-t'th'ak]] crafted the mechno-chair used by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Nute Gunray.<ref name="LOE" /> The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vana Sage]] once contacted a [[Unidentified Xi Char engineer|rogue Xi Char engineer]] who helped her design a unique starfighter. Dubbed the ''[[Guardian Mantis]]'', the stealth fighter was exceedingly fast.<ref name="State of the Arts">{{GamerCite|2|State of the Arts}}</ref>
